phase.title: Configure the orchestration pilot and shared policy

summary: Implemented Phase 1: added the shared preset and root Renovate config, official validator workflow, chart/tool/image annotations, canonical policy documentation, ownership/README/CI/AGENTS links, and coverage report. Extraction found 95 occurrences across 34 files. Strict validation, actionlint, bash -n, ShellCheck, diff checks, static security guardrails, and guardrail self-tests passed; existing dependency selections are unchanged. Policy decisions preserve digest pinning, first-party release ownership, ARM64 review, checksum contracts, security scheduling, and approval gates. Blocker: Renovate local mode downgrades full dry runs to lookup-only, the preset is unpublished, no GitHub read token is available, and anonymous registry retries produced host failures. A true no-write hosted full dry run therefore requires external publication/read credentials and stable registry access. Handoff: docs/dependency-automation.md and docs/research/dependency-automation-coverage.md.
